meta.title: Goth Botanical Portfolio — Design File for Claude
meta.author: User
meta.purpose: Provide a single-file, structured design spec Claude can consume to generate components, HTML/CSS, content, or design tokens for a goth-botanical portfolio site.

productBrief.intent: Computer Science graduate portfolio with Landing, About, Contact, and Projects pages.
productBrief.theme: Goth botanical — dark floral backgrounds, vintage ornamental frames, moths, black cat silhouettes. No gradients, no emojis, no modern glossy UI; keep a vintage-print, high-contrast aesthetic.
productBrief.audience: Recruiters, collaborators, and researchers seeking a CS graduate with UI/UX sensibility and full-stack experience.

primary.usage: Main landing background, selected states, cards, active elements

secondary.usage: Contact-page background, subtle accents (pins), sparing use only

textOnLight.usage: Text when background is #ededed or white

accentSeal.usage: Small decorative elements such as stamps or labels (optional)

constraints: Maintain vintage/gothic feel: ornamental borders, textured paper imagery, print-like typography

structure: Hero (large centered ornamental frame with name)
landing.visualNotes: Hero uses full-screen background of dark floral image overlaid by nothing (do not apply gradient). Title uses heading font in high-contrast #ededed. Selected language/button uses primary color #220810 as a small rounded rectangle or inset panel. Keep ornamental vintage frame SVG above/beside name.

structure: Left: portrait in an ornamental oval frame
Center-left: About Me text block with decorative separators
Right: Education and Skills columns with vintage icons and pinned notes
about.visualNotes: Use paper texture cards for pinned notes. Pins should use secondary (#1C141D) sparingly. Skill icons may be simple envelopes/frames with dark borders and light fill. Keep spacing airy and centered alignment for readability.

structure: Pinned notes around the form and small cat silhouette in the corner
contact.visualNotes: Contact page background is bckgrnd1.jfif. Input lines are single-rule (underline) style in muted text color. Send button is a small vintage button with black text and transparent background.

structure: Tabbed filter row (Work Experience / Academic Projects / Research Projects)
Project cards in a single column on left or masonry depending on screen width
projects.visualNotes: Project cards are framed vintage posters with a small title band beneath (heading font). Hover effect: subtle lift (no bright glows), e.g., 6px translateY and shadow with low opacity. Maintain dark floral background behind cards.

nav.layout: Top-right language selector & top-left minimal logo (initials inside small frame). Navigation links are small uppercase with the heading font.
nav.states: Active/selected uses primary #220810 as background for the small pill; otherwise links are text #ededed with thin borders for hovered focus.
nav.accessibility: Focus indicator must be a visible 2px outline in --color-text with clear contrast.

buttons.states: Hover should slightly darken the background value; active shows inset shadow. No bright color shifts.

cards.frame: Decorative SVG border around the card. Inner content sits on slightly textured paper (#f6f2ef tint only where necessary). Main card background on landing uses primary color rather than light paper.
cards.imageTreatment: Black-and-white or desaturated images inside a burgundy-tinted frame. Avoid color saturation that breaks goth vibe.

form.inputs: Underline inputs, placeholder text in muted color, label above in Tinos small uppercase.
form.submit: Small rectangular vintage button; when disabled, lower opacity and no pointer cursor.

assetsAndIllustrationGuidance.backgrounds: High-resolution dark floral image(s). Provide one hero background and one repeated pattern for sections. Keep file sizes reasonable and apply lazy-loading.
assetsAndIllustrationGuidance.ornaments: Provide SVG ornamental borders/frames (thin stroke, not filled). Keep them monochrome (#ededed) so they contrast on dark backgrounds.
assetsAndIllustrationGuidance.icons: Black cat silhouette (SVG), moth illustration (SVG), small envelope/postage motifs. Keep silhouettes simple, sharp edges, single-color fills.
assetsAndIllustrationGuidance.textures: Paper texture JPEG/PNG for the central cards (subtle, low-contrast), used sparingly to avoid visual noise.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on dark backgrounds passes AA (4.5:1) where body text appears; headings can be larger and use higher contrast.
accessibility.keyboard: All interactive elements (nav, tabs, buttons, form inputs) must be keyboard reachable and have visible focus styles.
accessibility.forms: Form fields must have associated labels. Use aria-live for form submission results. Provide reCAPTCHA alternative only if required.

developerNotes.css: Use CSS variables for tokens; avoid component libraries that inject gradients or heavy default styles. Keep CSS reset minimal and prefer custom components.
developerNotes.fonts: Load heading font (Manufacturing Consent) and Tinos from a reliable host (self-host or a licensing-compliant provider). If Manufacturing Consent is unavailable, choose a similarly ornate serif with high contrast.
developerNotes.performance: Optimize background images with WebP fallbacks and lazy loading for non-hero backgrounds. Inline small SVG ornaments where practical for crisp rendering.
no: No modern flat UI that conflicts with vintage aesthetic

claudeUsageGuide.goal: How to instruct Claude using this file

examples.task: Generate CSS variables and a small CSS file for the tokens
examples.prompt: Using the design tokens in the provided JSON, generate a small CSS file that declares variables for colors, spacing, and fonts, plus basic body, h1, and button styles. Do not add gradients or emojis. Keep styles minimal and semantic.

examples.task: Produce an accessible HTML template for the contact page
examples.prompt: Using the contact page spec, produce a semantic HTML template with the paper-card centered form, labeled inputs, and the suggested decorative SVG placeholders. Include class names that match the component tokens and add comments where SVG assets should be placed.

examples.task: Export a component spec for Figma or Claude to generate frames
examples.prompt: Create a component-by-component spec (widths, padding, fonts, colors) for Figma frames: hero, card, nav, and form card. Provide measurements in px for a desktop 1440px artboard. Use the tokens in this file.

deliverables: Suggested next: Generate CSS, HTML templates, or Figma frames using Claude with prompts included above.
